title: Magpie in the margin
note: A magpie perched in the margin of a manuscript page with a pen nib in its bill: watercolour washes, body colour and ink on vellum, with gold leaf. Written by paintings/magpie.gen.mjs.

tint.note: a thin glaze that stays where it is put

stain.note: what age leaves on the skin

quill ink.note: carbon ink from a quill; dry before the next touch

colour.note: pigment in glair, for the small bright things

lead white.note: thick white that keeps the mark of the brush

bar leaf.note: the leaf of the bar and the border

plumage.note: black body colour with a little gloss; it stays wet long enough to be worked into

sheen blue.note: dark paint full of interference flakes: the gloss of the feathers

gloss.note: a clear medium full of interference flakes: no colour of its own, only what the light gives it, and that changes with the slope of the paint beneath

nib ink.note: ink still wet on the point

vane.note: the whole vane of a feather, or a stem, in one shaped stroke

scumble.note: a nearly dry brush dragged along

dry feather.note: almost dry, so that it catches only on the ridges of the paint beneath

sketch.note: a quill that is in a hurry

steps.name: The vellum
steps.note: What the skin brings with it: stains, follicles, the marks of the scraper.

steps.name: Ruling and script
steps.note: The text column at the edge of the page, written before anything was painted.

steps.name: Gold leaf
steps.note: A bar of leaf on raised gesso between the picture and the text, with its blue fillet.

steps.name: Border sprays
steps.note: Pen tendrils with ivy leaves and bezants in gold, a few flowers and berries.

steps.name: Underdrawing
steps.note: A few searching lines in thin brown ink.

steps.name: Tail
steps.note: Six long feathers, green where the light catches them; they run off the page.

steps.name: The perch
steps.note: A stem that springs from the gold bar, with painted leaves.

steps.name: First washes
steps.note: Watercolour, wet: a pale blue that overruns the drawing, indigo for the black, colours dropped in while it is wet.

steps.name: White plumage
steps.note: Lead white over grey: broad wet strokes first, drier ones over them, then the point of the brush.

steps.name: Legs
steps.note: Dark horn, scaled; the toes close round the stem.

steps.name: Wing
steps.note: Seven flight feathers, blue along the outer webs, and three rows of coverts over their bases.

steps.name: Black plumage
steps.note: Blocked in dark, then every small feather modelled toward the light, then the point of the brush.

steps.name: Scapulars
steps.note: The white shoulder patch, laid over the dry black.

steps.name: Iridescent gloss
steps.note: Paint with interference flakes in it, scumbled where the light catches the feather tracts: blue and green, a little violet.

steps.name: Feather edges
steps.note: Stray hairs that break the outline, so that it is plumage and not a cut-out.

steps.name: The nib
steps.note: A gilt pen nib held by its shank: slit, breather hole, and ink still wet on the point.

steps.name: Bill and eye
steps.note: Horn-black bill with one cold light along the culmen; the eye, dark and wet.

steps.name: Pen work
steps.note: The pen goes round once more, never quite where the brush went.
